headline:
Fresh paint.

intro: Family-owned house painters in Lubbock and across the South Plains. You deal with Tom or one of his sons, and we do all the work ourselves.
servicesIntro: One room or the whole house. Every estimate is free and flat.

services.name: Exterior painting
services.text: We paint brick, siding and trim. We scrape, caulk and prime where needed, then apply at least 2 coats of Sherwin-Williams paint.

services.name: Interior painting
services.text: We mask everything off first, then paint walls, ceilings, trim and more, in one room or the whole house.

services.name: Cabinet painting
services.text: Kitchen cabinets and bathroom vanities, even natural wood that has never been painted.

services.name: Staining and oiling
services.text: Fences, decks, gazebos and cedar houses, usually with Wood Defender or linseed oil.

services.name: Drywall and wood-rot repair
services.text: We repair and retexture drywall and replace rotten wood, from fascia boards to siding.

services.name: Stucco repair
services.text: Cracks and chips patched and texture-matched.

why.name: Family owned, four generations
why.text: You deal with Tom or one of his sons from estimate to final coat. The person you talked to is the person holding the brush.

why.name: No money up front on most jobs
why.text: You pay when the job is completely done. We buy all the supplies.

why.name: Always on time
why.text: We show up on time for the estimate. If something comes up, we call right away.

howTitle: A fresh coat in three steps.

steps.name: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: We look at the work, ask questions and give you a flat price.

steps.name: We prep and paint
steps.text: We mask, scrape, caulk and prime, then paint. We buy all the supplies.

steps.name: Pay when it is done
steps.text: On most jobs, you pay nothing until everything is completely finished.
